explanation: The item she called a pillow was actually a severed human hand. She had attacked someone she knew, cut off that person's hand, and carried it in her luggage along with ordinary overnight items. When security inspected the case, they found the hand and arrested her for the assault.

The suspicious “pillow” concealed the severed hand of someone the woman knew. She had assaulted that person and cut off the hand while the victim was alive, then carried it through the baggage checkpoint among her overnight belongings. Security found the hand when they inspected the luggage, exposing the assault, and arrested her.
